text:
This presentation fits irritable bowel syndrome, which involves the colon. Its sympathetic innervation comes from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column (lateral horn) of the spinal cord at about T10-L2. Fibers to the midgut portion (to the mid-transverse colon) travel in the lesser and least thoracic splanchnic nerves to the superior mesenteric ganglion. Fibers to the hindgut portion travel in the lumbar splanchnic nerves (L1-L2) to the inferior mesenteric ganglion.

CONFIDENCE: 80
